exposure: History of one or two cesarean deliveries
outcome: Attempted trial of labor after cesarean (TOLAC)
cohort: Individuals with a history of one or two cesarean deliveries in the National Vital Statistics System
finding: The rate of attempted and successful trial of labor after cesarean (TOLAC), as well as the VBAC rate, increased from 2010 to 2020 among individuals with a history of one or two cesarean deliveries.
mod_finding: This study assessed trends in vaginal birth after cesarean (VBAC) delivery and found that both attempted and successful trial of labor after cesarean (TOLAC) deliveries have increased.
